newsitem.title: FRANCE: U.N. envoy in France to meet Mobutu.
newsitem.headline: U.N. envoy in France to meet Mobutu.

text.p: The U.N. envoy dealing with the crisis in eastern Zaire has arrived in France for talks with Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, convalescing in a luxury villa on the French Riviera.
Raymond Chretien arrived at Nice airport late on Monday and went to stay overnight at a hotel in Menton, a town near Mobutu's mansion overlooking the Mediterranean at Roquebrune-Cap-Martin.
Chretien, who is also Canada's ambassador to the United States, met Mobutu last month days after the ailing leader arrived from Switzerland where he underwent surgery for prostate cancer in August.
It was unknown when Chretien might meet Mobutu.
Rwandan-backed Tutsi rebels in eastern Zaire have seized more territory in fighting against Mobutu's troops and claimed to have entered the eastern region's biggest city, Kisangani.
The embattled government denied the rebels had taken parts of Kisangani, the site of a major air base, but admitted the loss of two other towns in weekend battles near the border with Uganda.
Fighting has intensifed since most of the 1.2 million Rwandan refugees who had fled to Zaire returned to their own country two weeks ago.
